name: D. M. McIntosh
bio: Dr. D. M. McIntosh of Glendive made professional visits to Medora in 1884, including treating Mrs. Fitzgerald's sick baby. In May 1885 the paper reported that he and Dr. Robarts had operated to remove a tumor from Mrs. Draper.
mentions: Dr. McIntosh, of Glendive, was in town Tuesday, attending Mrs. Fitzgerald's baby, which was quite sick the first of the week.
Dr. McIntosh, of Glendive, made Medora a short visit on Tuesday.
Dr. D. M. McIntosh came down from Glendive yesterday on professional business.
…s. Draper is still very ill, although the operation for the removal of a tumor, performed by Drs. Robarts and McIntosh seems to have benefitted her.
